Jordan M: Quick snapshot for GTN/product — bringing up Kestrel-9 for onboarding. Sharing a short cost-vs-quality signal summary and proposed routing handoff.

Sophia L: TL;DR: int8 saves ~33% token cost, median latency +5ms, accuracy delta -0.9% on our QA slice (mostly short QA). Hybrid int6 reduces cost ~20% with -0.3% accuracy.

Jordan M: Can you paste the quick numbers? Need a short blurb product can act on.

Sophia L: ```
slice         | fp16 perf | int8 perf | int8 delta | cost delta
QA-short     | 0.874     | 0.866     | -0.9%      | -33%
Longform     | 0.812     | 0.805     | -0.9%      | -34%
Conversational| 0.892    | 0.885     | -0.8%      | -32%
Hybrid(int6) | 0.869     | 0.866     | -0.3%      | -20%
```
Numbers are averages across 10k samples; CI ~0.15pt.

Liam K: Heads-up: 95p tail latency increased from ~280ms -> ~420ms on int8 in our microbench with continuous batching. Throughput looks fine but tail hits under burst.

Anita P: Product constraints — our GTN customers require <400ms 95p for interactive flows and tolerate up to 1.5% QA drop. GTN target is 5% overall cost reduction.

Jordan M: Proposed routing plan: default int8 small-batch for interactive routes (with reduced batch size), hybrid int6 for longform generation, and fp16 fallback for flagged slices. Rollout as canary 5% traffic for 48h with automatic rollback on QA delta >1% or hallucination spike.

ci-bot: build #238 | smoke tests: unit ok, integration ok, regressions: recall delta 0.7% on longform test (alert created: #INC-2021).

Sophia L: Ops mitigation: enable prefix KV cache and dynamic batching (max batch latency cap = 80ms) — should bring 95p tail down ~100ms in our tests. Also recommend headroom routing to fp16 when tail >400ms.

Jordan M: Ask to Product/GTN: can we start a 5% canary for 48 hours? If yes we will push config, monitor econ dashboard (tokens/s, cost/unit) + quality scorecard (QA recall, hallucination rate, latency 50/95/99).

Anita P: OK to start 5% canary for GTN. Please create a one-page scorecard and a short playbook for rollback. @Sophia L — can you own the scorecard?

Sophia L: Yep — I'll produce a compact scorecard with thresholds and the eval commands by EOD. :thumbsup:

Liam K: I'll add tail latency metrics and a breach alert to the SLO dashboard; alert if QA delta >1% or 95p latency >400ms for 10m window.

Jordan M: SGTM. Once scorecard ready we coordinate canary start and monitoring handoff. Thanks all.
